entry_points.summary: Appends structured JSON event to run events.jsonl and repo-wide metrics.jsonl; flock-safe.
Sugar over log-event.sh; start/end/wrap modes emit <phase>_start/_end with wall_ms.
Scans docs/llm/*.json, collects memories[], writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically.
Emits JSON blob with plugin git SHA, dirty flag, branch, optional tag.
Gate script for memory-review agent; <RUN> <parent_command>; 5-line stdout contract; single memory_review_terminal event on skip.
CLI: extracts dismissed MR-review finding signatures from consecutive archive run pairs; outputs {signatures, n_runs_scanned}.
Pairwise algorithm: R_i snapshot vs R_{i+1}.previous-* user-edited copy to find dismissed findings.
Rsync local tree to ~/dev/qt-bot-sandbox/<slug>/<task-id>/ on remote host; invoked by remote-runner agent.

invariants: All scripts require python3 for JSON handling, timing fallbacks, and document generation.
All scripts resolve the repo root via git rev-parse or pwd fallback.
log-event.sh and log-phase.sh honor Z_HARNESS_SLUG for slug-namespaced vs. legacy flat plan layout.
log-event.sh sources scripts/plan-path.sh for canonical and legacy plan path resolution.
regenerate-memories-flat.py writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically via os.replace on a temp file.
run-memory-review.sh always exits 0; skip conditions are communicated via STATUS: line on stdout.
run-memory-review.sh accepts exactly two positional args: <RUN> <parent_command>.

run-memory-review.sh stdout line 1 is always STATUS: ready | STATUS: skipped <reason>; lines 2-4 are diff, SPEC (or empty), TAGS paths when ready; line 5 is DEBUG.md path when parent_command is debug.
run-memory-review.sh emits exactly one memory_review_terminal event on all skip paths; orchestrator owns it for non-skip paths.
extract-dismissals.py outputs JSON {signatures, n_runs_scanned} to stdout; exit 0 even when no dismissals found.
gotchas: run-memory-review.sh parent_command=debug adds a third skip condition: STATUS: skipped debug_md_missing if DEBUG.md is absent or unreadable.
run-memory-review.sh _build_terminal_payload has a pure-bash JSON fallback for environments without python3.
macOS BSD date lacks %3N support; log-phase.sh falls back to python3 time.time()*1000.
log-event.sh silently wraps non-JSON payloads as {"raw": ...} instead of failing.
log-event.sh mid-flight legacy detection: writes to old flat path if run dir already exists there.
run-memory-review.sh disables pipefail around git diff | head -n 5000 to tolerate SIGPIPE.
version.sh degrades gracefully if plugin root is not a git repo, returning non-git sentinel values.
extract-dismissals.py drops findings lacking a title field; does NOT fall back to T-MR-NNN ids (renumbered each run).
remote-sandbox-sync.sh warns but does not fail when no .z-harness-rsync-exclude is found.
